title: Get Rid of Your Stuff
coreMove: Stuff is not passive: each item asks for space and care from you, so rank what serves your daily routine and remove what keeps managing you from the room.

exampleSpecs.audience: people whose rooms keep managing them
exampleSpecs.stakes: show simplicity as physical support for the real routine
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Nora removes the standing pile so move-out sorting can happen

exampleSpecs.audience: people who confuse backup with attachment
exampleSpecs.stakes: make a possession visible by counting handling cost
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Cam finds the duplicate that slows every search

exampleSpecs.audience: people arguing with possible use while today's route is blocked
exampleSpecs.stakes: rank what serves the current routine
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Mara keeps one useful bin and clears the path before class begins

exampleSpecs.audience: people planning around friction before clutter sets the pace
exampleSpecs.stakes: give space time before the task begins

exampleSpecs.audience: people balancing care for memory with limits on public space

exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Sloane keeps enough for real use and clears the rest from the routine
